vocabulary.example_ko: 한국은 네 가지 뚜렷한 기후가 있어요.

vocabulary.example: Climate change is a global issue.
The forecast says it will rain.

grammar.explanation_en: Compare weather with comparatives ('It's colder than yesterday'), predict weather with 'will' ('It will rain tomorrow'), and confirm information with question tags — a positive statement gets a negative tag, and vice versa: 'It's hot, isn't it?' / 'It won't rain, will it?'
grammar.explanation_ko: 비교급으로 날씨를 비교하고('It's colder than yesterday'), will로 날씨를 예측하며('It will rain tomorrow'), 부가의문문으로 확인합니다 — 긍정문에는 부정 부가의문문, 부정문에는 긍정 부가의문문을 씁니다: 'It's hot, isn't it?' / 'It won't rain, will it?'

examples.en: I think it will snow this weekend.
examples.ko: 이번 주말에 눈이 올 것 같아요.

examples.en: It's really hot today, isn't it?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.line: It's really humid today, isn't it?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.line: Yes, it is. The forecast says it will rain later.
dialogue.line_ko: 네, 맞아요. 일기예보에서 나중에 비가 온대요.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.line: Is it getting warmer these days?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.line: Yes, it's warmer than last week.

reading.title: Changing Weather
reading.text: Many scientists say the climate is changing. Summers are getting hotter, and winters are getting shorter than before. This year, the temperature reached 38 degrees in July — hotter than any summer in the past ten years. The forecast predicts this pattern will continue.
reading.text_ko: 많은 과학자들이 기후가 변하고 있다고 말해요. 여름은 점점 더워지고, 겨울은 예전보다 짧아지고 있어요. 올해 7월에는 기온이 38도까지 올라갔는데, 지난 10년 중 어느 여름보다 더워요. 일기예보는 이런 패턴이 계속될 것으로 예상해요.

explanation.en: The text says 'Summers are getting hotter.'
The text says 'the temperature reached 38 degrees in July.'
The text says 'hotter than any summer in the past ten years.'
explanation.ko: 본문에 'hotter than any summer in the past ten years'라고 나옵니다.
